### 2026-10-29: Days before as well as today, I looked through the guides and decided that I found the 7-segment display interesting.

**1.5h**

Days before as well as today, I looked through the guides and decided that I found the 7-segment display interesting.

I wanted to do the middle difficultly in the guide, however, the words were kind of hard to translate into actual connections, so I decided to look to the internet and sure enough, I saw a diagram/website that explained the pins and connections that the seven segment display needed, as all the warning about permanently killing the LED segment was concerning me and I couldn't really understand how many resistors or transistors were needed.

The website -->
https://www.onetransistor.eu/2018/12/wiring-of-4digit-7segment-display.html

An image from the website explains the why the pins that are apart of the 7-segment display were even there -->

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/xLV9v2yZsf8cQU2Q5GZ9YV3OSKXKe8Gz/8205ffa243ef30a0a6b36ed492a1b1fff58f8d5b61703925c4d222d464da8ec7.png)

It also shows how to wire the component -->

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/xLV9v2yZsf8cQU2Q5GZ9YV3OSKXKe8Gz/f9dc345ab1847cdf3bbf951659871d3d7db8fd442c4d594f01f917b1c9c838ff.png)

I selected some parts to put on the schematic diagram -->

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/xLV9v2yZsf8cQU2Q5GZ9YV3OSKXKe8Gz/b8951afcd57c8875b9d50064ab2ed1688ca358bb5cb6ad9dd12f017c4758ad4c.png)

Thanks to this website, I will find putting the 7 segment display much easier to understand and do.

That's all for today.
